channel.title: InvestPR Media Monitoring
channel.description: Defense-textile manufacturing was the week's clearest win: Pentaq's $41M Army contract and Sabana Grande expansion (50 jobs) sits inside a broader $119M, nine-month run of Pentagon awards to Puerto Rico textile makers, alongside Abbott's $3.2M Arecibo expansion and a $45M Army microgrid contract at Fort Buchanan. Federal capital kept flowing for resilience infrastructure (FEMA awards from $5M to $86M, a $122M San Juan bond return to market), and the Ports Authority repealed a ~$25M/year container-scanning fee.
